# Philip Norman

## About the Author

**Philip Norman** was born in London and brought up on the Isle of Wight. He joined the _Sunday Times_ at the age of twenty-two, soon gaining a reputation as Atticus columnist and for his profiles of figures as diverse as Elizabeth Taylor, P. G. Wodehouse, Little Richard, and Colonel Gaddafi. As a noted music biographer, he has received acclaim for multiple works including _SHOUT!_ , a ground-breaking biography of the Beatles that was a bestseller in both Britain and the US, and _John Lennon: The Life_ , which the _New York Times_ called “a mammoth, haunting, terrific piece of work.” He has also written the definitive lives of Sir Elton John, Buddy Holly, George Harrison, Mick Jagger, Paul McCartney, Eric Clapton, and Jimi Hendrix.
